description:
Check your Vercel deployments from your iPhone or iPad. Taktung brings production status, website analytics, build logs, visual comparison and a local Field Log into one place.

- See your site's production state and recent deployments.
- Follow Vercel Web Analytics usage: visitors, page views, daily traffic, top pages, referrers, countries and devices. Choose a 7-day or 30-day period within your Vercel plan’s reporting window. Web Analytics must be enabled and installed on the website.
- Compare real page captures with a reveal slider or side-by-side view. Save a baseline for the next deployment.
- Investigate failed builds with searchable build logs and a bounded live runtime log stream.
- Inspect project activity, domains, deployment checks, cron schedules and feature flag names.
- Check environment variable names and targets without exposing values.
- Keep checks, comparisons and personal notes in a searchable local Field Log with text export.
- Add small, medium or large Home Screen widgets. Choose all projects or one project; the large widget also shows recent deployment activity.
- Ask Siri for deployment status, or use Shortcuts to inspect a project and check its loaded signals.
- Review and confirm redeploy, promote and rollback actions.

Connect with a Vercel personal access token, stored in the device Keychain. Taktung calls Vercel directly; history and saved baselines stay on this device, separated by account and team.

Choose Light, Dark or System appearance. Layouts adapt to iPhone, expanded iPhone Duo and iPad.

On compatible devices with Apple Intelligence available, site briefs can be summarized locally. Standard diagnosis remains available on every supported device.

Optional tips in Settings support Taktung’s development. Tips can be repeated and do not unlock features or start a subscription.

Requires iOS 27 or later and a Vercel account.

Taktung is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by Vercel.
promotionalText: Follow Vercel website traffic from your iPhone or iPad. Check visitors, page views, top pages and traffic sources alongside deploy status, logs and widgets.
whatsNew: Bug fixes. Analytics now loads visitors, page views and breakdowns for your sites, and errors from Vercel now explain what went wrong instead of blaming your connection.
